What do you think of using _storage_ instead of two identical lines, one for _localStorage_ and one for _sessionStorage_? I'm on the fence. I like writing the code similar to what web developers would write, but on the other hand this is supposed to be more API documentation, and from that perspective documenting "the Storage interface" using a generic variable seems better. We could even add an intro dl along the lines of `storage = window . localStorage / storage = window . sessionStorage / Retrieves the appropriate storage object?" Maybe that's just weird though.
